faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer post is 12th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate with Science from Uttarakhand/UP Board or equivalent and possess a Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) from a recognized institution. Registration with the Uttarakhand Pharmacy Council is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer post is between 18 years and 42 years. Age relaxation will be provided for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 28 vacancies announced for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer position in the Animal Husbandry Department of Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in Pay Level-6, ranging from Rs. 35,400 to Rs. 1,12,400 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Veterinary Pharmacy Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on a merit list prepared from the marks obtained in the Diploma examination, followed by year-wise list preparation as per the relevant service rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 300. For SC/ST candidates, the fee is Rs. 150.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Animal Husbandry Department Uttarakhand, which is www.v.anr.uk.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided to candidates belonging to reserved categories as per the prevailing rules and regulations of the Uttarakhand government.
